assays.assay_description: Transparent cages with ~4.5 cm fine sawdust, 20 glass marbles in 5×4 pattern, 30-min session. Number of buried marbles counted. Tested with psilocybin alone and in combination with M100907, 8-OH-DPAT, WAY100635, buspirone, escitalopram; also bolus vs staggered dosing and 7-day persistence.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection in a standard injection volume of 300 µl 30 min before the MBT.

setup_habituation.evidence: All mice underwent a pretest without any injection, and the number of marbles buried was counted.

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were left in the cage with the marbles for a 30-min period

food_restriction.evidence: MBT performed in transparent cages containing sawdust and marbles; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: MBT performed in transparent cages containing sawdust and marbles; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection... 30 min before the MBT.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (4.4 mg/kg) significantly reduced marble burying by ~33% vs vehicle, comparable to escitalopram. The effect was not blocked by 5-HT2A antagonist M100907 nor by 5-HT1A antagonist WAY100635. 8-OH-DPAT also reduced burying with an additive effect to psilocybin, while buspirone reduced burying but did not add to psilocybin. The effect did not persist at 7 days and required bolus rather than staggered dosing.
outcomes.statistics: One-way ANOVA F6,56 = 15.33, p < 0.0001; psilocybin main effect F1,40 = 24.8, p < 0.0001; M100907 main effect F1,40 = 7.7, p = 0.008; 8-OH-DPAT F1,37 = 74.3, p < 0.0001; psilocybin×DPAT interaction F1,37 = 0.9, p = 0.34; WAY×psilocybin F1,61 = 0.0003, p = 0.985; buspirone×psilocybin F1,75 = 5.805, p = 0.018; 7-day follow-up p = 0.53.
outcomes.evidence: Mice administered psilocybin buried 32.84% fewer marbles over 30 min than vehicle-treated mice (p = 0.001). No significant effect of psilocybin was observed (vehicle 18.6 ± 1.6, n = 5; psilocybin 17.75 ± 2.21, n = 4; p = 0.53) at 7 days.

assays.assay_description: Square wooden arena (50 × 50 × 40 cm) with white walls and black floor; mice explored for 30 min immediately after MBT. Total distance traveled, center duration, and periphery duration measured via Ethovision XT-12.

application_type.evidence: Drugs were administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection... The OFT was performed immediately after the MBT

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper does not mention OFT-specific habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore the apparatus for 30 min

time_to_assay.evidence: OFT was performed immediately after the MBT... activity measurements were... 60-90 min after psilocybin administration

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin and buspirone had no significant effect on distance traveled, time in center, or time in periphery compared to vehicle, indicating effects on marble burying were not due to altered locomotion.
outcomes.evidence: there was no significant difference in distance traveled between vehicle-treated mice and those administered psilocybin or buspirone.

assays.assay_description: Magnetometer-based HTR assay over 20 min immediately after injection of vehicle, psilocybin 4.4 mg/kg, buspirone 5 mg/kg, or combination. Small neodymium magnets attached to outer ears; signal recorded at 1000 Hz and processed via custom MATLAB script.

application_type.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus... immediately after injection of vehicle or psilocybin 4.4 mg/kg (i.p. route described for all drug experiments)

setup_habituation.evidence: After a 5- to 7-day recovery period (from ear-magnet attachment); apparatus habituation not described

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus (freely moving; no restraint described)

time_to_assay.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus... immediately after injection of vehicle or psilocybin 4.4 mg/kg

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin 4.4 mg/kg significantly increased total head twitches over 20 min compared to vehicle, and HTR varied across the 20-min time course. Co-administration of buspirone 5 mg/kg significantly attenuated the psilocybin-induced HTR.
outcomes.statistics: F3,32 = 12.87, p < 0.0001; psilocybin F1,32 = 19.22, p = 0.0001; buspirone F1,32 = 7.483, p = 0.0101; psilocybin×buspirone F1,32 = 5.237, p = 0.0289; time F9,288 = 5.001, p = 0.0032; time×psilocybin F9,288 = 3.224, p = 0.001; buspirone+psilocybin vs psilocybin p = 0.0009.
outcomes.evidence: there was a significant effect of psilocybin to increase HTR compared to vehicle (p < 0.001), while buspirone and buspirone + psilocybin effects were significantly lower than the effect of psilocybin (p = 0.0002 and p = 0.0009, respectively).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Three-way ANOVA with repeated measures showed a significant within-subjects effect of time (F9,288 = 5.001, p < 0.0032), reflecting the changes in HTR rate during the course of the test

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR explicitly excluded from ethological behaviors per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Magnetometer signal processed via custom MATLAB script (signal detection, not behavioral classifier)

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described in magnetometer apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) was measured over 20 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single HTR test session per animal

judge_notes: Three distinct assays identified: MBT, OFT, and HTR. All candidates agreed on assay structure.
B1 MBT: scored 0 (single measure = marbles buried). One candidate inflated to 1; corrected based on rubric (1 measure = 0 points).
B4 MBT: scored Yes — burying/digging is an ethological behavior from the species' natural repertoire, per rubric examples.
MBT D1 set to Multiple discrete sessions (pretest + test + 7-day retest in subset) and D3 to 2-7 days accordingly.
MBT setup_habituation: scored 'yes' because mice underwent a pretest in the same apparatus without injection.
B7 across assays: Ethovision and custom MATLAB peak detection both score 0 per explicit rubric guidance.
Housing day_night_flipped marked not_reported (medium confidence) because paper states a 12-h light/dark cycle but does not specify direction.
